title: CVE-2026-29001 — TastyIgniter 4.4.5 PHP Object Injection via Settings Deserialization
summary: Affected: TastyIgniter TastyIgniter through 4.4.5 contains a PHP object injection vulnerability that allows authenticated administrators to achieve arbitrary code execution by submitting a serialized PHP object as a settings value, which is stored unsanitized and later unserialized by getValueAttribute() when the setting is read. Attackers can submit a serialized gadget chain, such as one generated via phpggc, through the admin settings form (for example the maintenance_message setting loaded by CheckMaintenance.php) to achieve arbitrary operating-system command execution as the PHP application process user, with the impact persisting until the value is overwritten.

title: CVE-2026-124552 — Webmin through 2.670 Stored XSS via Shorewall and Shorewall6 list.cgi
summary: Affected: webmin Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the Shorewall and Shorewall6 modules' list.cgi, which renders table fields and COMMENT lines unescaped. Authenticated users with table edit permission can store JavaScript via savecmt.cgi or table entries that executes when other users, including root, view the list page.

title: CVE-2026-124551 — ClassroomIO through 1.0.0 Cross-Organization Course Disclosure via Clone Endpoint
summary: Affected: classroomio ClassroomIO through 1.0.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users of any organization to clone other tenants' courses via the POST /course/:courseId/clone endpoint. Attackers who know a target course id can copy its sections, lessons, exercises, and quiz answer keys into their own organization, exposing private course content.

title: CVE-2026-124494 — SunEditor before 3.4.0 Stored XSS via : Entity Sanitizer Bypass
summary: Affected: JiHong88 suneditor SunEditor before 3.4.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability because the html.clean() sanitizer's _normalizeURL() function decodes named entities like : to an empty string. Attackers can inject href values such as javascript: that pass the _isSafeURL() check but are decoded by browsers, executing JavaScript when victims click stored links.

title: CVE-2026-124493 — SunEditor before 3.4.0 Stored XSS via DocumentType Header textContent
summary: Affected: JiHong88 suneditor SunEditor before 3.4.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the DocumentType constructor that injects header textContent into innerHTML without HTML escaping. Attackers can store entity-encoded HTML in h1-h6 headers that executes JavaScript when editors using document:header mode initialize, enabling session cookie theft.

title: CVE-2026-124492 — SunEditor before 3.4.0 Stored XSS via Link Modal Bookmark List
summary: Affected: JiHong88 suneditor SunEditor before 3.4.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in ModalAnchorEditor's #createBookmarkList, which inserts entity-decoded h1-h6 header textContent into the bookmark list via innerHTML without escaping. Attackers can store HTML-encoded payloads in editor headers that execute JavaScript when a victim opens the link modal and types # in the URL input.

title: CVE-2026-124491 — SunEditor before 3.4.0 Stored XSS via FileUpload Plugin Filename
summary: Affected: JiHong88 suneditor SunEditor before 3.4.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the FileUpload plugin create() method that assigns server-returned file names to innerHTML without escaping. Attackers can upload files with HTML-laden names that bypass html.clean() and execute JavaScript in victims' browsers when content or gallery items load, enabling session theft.

title: CVE-2026-124490 — OpenEMR before 8.3.0 Arbitrary File Read/Write via oe-module-faxsms disposeDocument
summary: Affected: openemr OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the RingCentral RCFaxClient disposeDocument() method of oe-module-faxsms that allows authenticated attackers to read and write arbitrary files via the file_path parameter. Attackers can use action=download to read credentials and source code, or action=setup with base64 content to write web-executable files for code execution.

title: CVE-2026-124489 — OpenEMR before 8.3.0 Broken Access Control via portal_payment.php
summary: Affected: openemr OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains a broken access control vulnerability in portal/portal_payment.php that allows low-privilege authenticated users to bypass billing ACL checks by tampering patient identifiers. Attackers can modify the pid and form_pid parameters to view payment pages and record fraudulent payment receipts for arbitrary patients, corrupting billing records.

title: CVE-2026-124488 — OpenEMR before 8.3.0 Authorization Bypass via load_form.php High-Sensitivity Encounters
summary: Affected: openemr OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated clinicians lacking high-sensitivity permission to read and modify encounter-bound forms via load_form.php. Attackers can request the Clinical Notes or Care Plan direct loader to obtain restricted content and a CSRF token, then submit save.php to tamper with clinical records.
